name: Rejection Reason 87 Code
definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction request has a rejected status.

DSEC.name: Invalid Security
DSEC.definition: Unrecognised or invalid financial instrument identification.

NMTY.name: Mismatch
NMTY.definition: Mismatch between option number and option type.

CANC.name: Option Cancelled
CANC.definition: Option is not valid; it has been cancelled by the market or service provider, and cannot be responded to. Any responses already processed against this option are considered void and new responses will be required.

INTV.name: Option Inactive
INTV.definition: Option is not active and can no longer be responded to. Any responses already processed against this option will remain valid, for example, expired option.

DUPL.name: Duplicate Instruction
DUPL.definition: Instruction is rejected due to duplicate business message identifier.

DSET.name: Denied Since Already Settled
DSET.definition: Cancellation request was denied because the instruction was already settled.

DCAN.name: Rejected Since Already Cancelled
DCAN.definition: Cancellation request was rejected since the instruction has already been cancelled.

BUMM.name: Buyer Protection Mismatch
BUMM.definition: Counterparty disagreement on the chosen corporate action outturn.

ECMD.name: Election To Counterparty Market Deadline Missed
ECMD.definition: Received after the election to counterparty market deadline.

ECRD.name: Election To Counterparty Response Deadline Missed
ECRD.definition: Received after the election to counterparty response market deadline.

DUCK.name: Underlying Transaction Cancelled
DUCK.definition: Buyer Protection instruction rejected since underlying settlement transaction has been cancelled.

DUST.name: Underlying Transaction Already Settled
DUST.definition: Buyer Protection instruction was rejected, because the underlying settlement transaction has already been settled.

DSNA.name: No Buyer Protection Allowed
DSNA.definition: Underlying transaction type/status does not allow for a buyer protection.
